description: Row counts of a DFlash target-verify batch at which a Kimi K3 routed-expert call runs on the one-rank DeepGEMM MegaMoE kernel with die-local weights (SGLANG_K3_ROUTED_MOE_DEEPGEMM). Every other row count, and every call outside target verify, runs trtllm-gen.
scope: Kimi K3.1, MoE EP with 112 experts per rank (896 experts, EP8), NVIDIA SM 10.7 with two locality domains
rule: widths: the row counts of a per-call benchmark (5 to 235 rows; reference = trtllm-gen with the serving engine's autotuned tactic, same process, same weights) at which the MegaMoE call was faster in every repetition. widths_ar_fusion: with SGLANG_K3_AR_FUSION a call of at most ar_fusion_fold_max_rows rows folds its finalize into the push all-reduce, which a MegaMoE call gives up; such a width is listed only if the kernel saves more than the folded finalize plus the latent copy (about 10 us per call, estimated from the finalize stage of a verify round), which none did. Widths above the fold limit are taken from widths unchanged.
not_listed: 5 rows (level with trtllm-gen) and row counts that were not timed, such as 205 and 215, stay on trtllm-gen.
regenerate: Time both kernels per row count on the target GPU and model with the engine's trtllm-gen tactic table, keep the row counts where the MegaMoE call wins in every repetition, and pass the file with SGLANG_K3_ROUTED_MOE_DEEPGEMM_VERIFY_WIDTHS.
